title: Spain Calls Early Election as Housing Crisis Grows
subtitle: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez hopes to win a new mandate after failing to pass emergency housing laws.

summary.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced a snap election for November 29. This decision follows a major defeat in Parliament where his government could not pass new housing laws. Across the country, citizens have been protesting against high rents and the lack of affordable homes. The opposition, led by the Popular Party, plans to focus their campaign on government corruption. This election will be a test for Sánchez, who has led the country since 2018.
summary.zh: 西班牙總理桑傑士宣布將於 11 月 29 日舉行提前大選。此決定是在其政府於國會遭遇重大挫敗、無法通過新住房法案後做出的。全國各地的公民一直在抗議高租金與缺乏可負擔住宅的問題。由人民黨領導的反對派計畫將競選重點放在政府貪腐議題上。這場選舉將是對自 2018 年執政至今的桑傑士的一場考驗。

paragraphs.en: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has announced that the country will hold a snap election on November 29. A snap election is a vote that happens earlier than planned. This decision comes after a difficult week for the government, which saw its emergency plans to fix the housing crisis fail in Parliament. The government had hoped to pass new rules to reduce evictions—the legal process of forcing someone to leave their home—and stop real estate speculation. However, opposition parties joined together to block these measures.
paragraphs.zh: 西班牙總理桑傑士 (Pedro Sánchez) 宣布，該國將於 11 月 29 日舉行提前大選。提前大選是指比原定計畫更早進行的投票。這項決定是在政府經歷艱難的一週後做出的，當時政府為解決住房危機所提出的緊急計畫在國會中遭到否決。政府原先希望通過新法規，以減少強制驅離（即透過法律程序迫使民眾搬離住處）並遏止房地產投機行為，然而反對黨聯合起來阻撓了這些措施。

paragraphs.en: This announcement follows days of intense public anger. As reported by NPR News, tens of thousands of people marched in cities across Spain over the weekend. These protesters were demanding better housing affordability and stronger protections for tenants. The public mood became very upset after a video showed the eviction of an 87-year-old woman in Madrid last month. This event became a symbol of the struggle many Spaniards face as they try to find homes they can afford.
paragraphs.zh: 這項宣布是在民眾連日表達強烈憤怒後發出的。根據美國國家公共廣播電台 (NPR) 報導，週末期間，西班牙各地城市有數萬人走上街頭。這些抗議者要求改善住房負擔能力，並加強對租屋族的保障。上個月一段影片顯示馬德里一名 87 歲的老婦人遭到驅離，引發公眾極大不滿。此事件成為許多西班牙人在尋找負擔得起的住處時，所面臨困境的象徵。

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Sánchez, who has been in power since 2018, explained his decision in a televised address. He argued that the Spanish people should now decide the future of the country. By calling for an early vote, Sánchez hopes to gain a stronger position in Parliament. Currently, he leads a minority government, which means he must rely on smaller parties to pass laws. This has made it very difficult for him to get things done. He believes that a new, broader group of supporters in Parliament would allow the government to solve the country's biggest problems.
paragraphs.zh: 自 2018 年起執政的桑傑士總理在電視演說中解釋了他的決定。他主張，西班牙人民現在應該親自決定國家的未來。透過要求提前投票，桑傑士希望在國會中取得更有利的地位。目前他領導的是少數政府，這意味著他必須依賴較小的政黨才能通過法案，這使得他推動政策變得非常困難。他相信，國會中若能擁有更廣泛的支持群體，將能讓政府解決國家面臨的最大問題。

paragraphs.en: However, the path to victory will not be easy. The opposition Popular Party, which already holds the most seats in Parliament, is ready to fight. Their leader, Alberto Núñez Feijóo, welcomed the news of the election. According to NPR News, Feijóo told the public that this vote is about changing the government and moving past the leadership of Sánchez. The opposition is expected to focus their campaign on recent legal cases involving the Socialist party, as well as questions about the prime minister’s family members, who have both denied doing anything wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，勝選之路並不容易。目前在國會中擁有最多席次的反對黨「人民黨」(Popular Party) 已準備好迎戰。該黨領袖費霍 (Alberto Núñez Feijóo) 對選舉消息表示歡迎。根據 NPR 報導，費霍向大眾表示，這場投票的重點在於更換政府，並告別桑傑士的領導。預計反對派將把競選重點放在近期涉及社會黨的法律案件，以及關於總理家人的質疑上，而其家人皆已否認有任何不當行為。

paragraphs.en: Experts suggest that the timing of the election is a calculated move. Oriol Bartomeus, a professor of political science at the Autonomous University of Barcelona, told NPR News that Sánchez is choosing this moment because the housing issue is very important to voters. By making housing the main topic of the election, the prime minister hopes to frame the debate in a way that helps his party. Bartomeus noted that Sánchez is trying to turn the election into a classic competition between left-wing and right-wing ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 專家認為，選舉時機的選擇是一項經過計算的策略。巴塞隆納自治大學 (Autonomous University of Barcelona) 的政治學教授巴托梅烏 (Oriol Bartomeus) 向 NPR 表示，桑傑士選擇此時機，是因為住房問題對選民而言至關重要。透過將住房議題作為選舉主軸，總理希望以有利於其政黨的方式來設定辯論方向。巴托梅烏指出，桑傑士正試圖將這場選舉轉變為左派與右派理念之間的經典對決。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the housing crisis, the prime minister faces other challenges. He has struggled to manage a difficult situation at the border in Ceuta, a Spanish territory in North Africa. Thousands of people have arrived there recently, creating a humanitarian crisis that has lasted for months. Additionally, while Spain has seen one of the fastest-growing economies in the developed world, the government has been weakened by its reliance on smaller parties to pass legislation. This has led to a sense of frustration among voters who want to see faster action on national issues.
paragraphs.zh: 除了住房危機外，總理還面臨其他挑戰。他一直難以處理位於北非的西班牙領土休達 (Ceuta) 邊境的棘手局勢。近期有數千人抵達當地，造成了持續數月的人道危機。此外，儘管西班牙擁有已開發國家中成長最快的經濟體之一，但政府因過度依賴小黨通過法案而顯得軟弱。這導致選民感到挫折，他們希望看到政府能更迅速地處理國家議題。

paragraphs.en: Sánchez has a reputation for being a "political escape artist," a term used to describe a leader who finds ways to win even when things look bad. Throughout his career, he has often surprised his critics by winning elections that many thought he would lose. Whether he can do it again remains to be seen. The upcoming campaign will be intense, as both sides prepare to present their vision for Spain’s future. For the people of Spain, the November vote will be a chance to express their views on the housing crisis, the economy, and the direction of their government.
paragraphs.zh: 桑傑士素有「政治脫逃大師」之稱，這個詞用來形容那些即便情勢看壞，仍能找到獲勝方法的領導人。在他的職業生涯中，他經常在許多人認為他會輸掉的選舉中獲勝，讓批評者大感意外。他是否能再次做到這一點仍有待觀察。即將到來的競選活動將會非常激烈，雙方都準備提出各自對西班牙未來的願景。對於西班牙人民來說，11 月的投票將是一個表達他們對住房危機、經濟以及政府發展方向看法的機會。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To stop something from happening or succeeding.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 阻礙、阻止（某事發生或成功）。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（街區、積木），這裡作動詞用。文中：However, opposition parties joined together to block these measures.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To present or express something in a particular way to influence how people perceive it.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 以特定方式呈現或表達，藉此影響大眾對該議題的看法。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作名詞（框架、畫框），這裡作動詞用。文中：By making housing the main topic of the election, the prime minister hopes to frame the debate in a way that helps his party.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To successfully complete tasks or achieve goals.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這是常見的慣用語，用來形容執行力或處理事務的能力。文中：This has made it very difficult for him to get things done.

While most protests were peaceful, some areas saw clashes between demonstrators and police. The government is now considering its next steps as public pressure continues to grow.

quiz.question: What was the immediate trigger for the government's failed attempt to pass new housing regulations in Parliament?

options.A: The opposition party's victory in the previous general election.
options.B: The failure of emergency plans designed to reduce evictions and stop speculation.
options.C: The public outcry following the eviction of an elderly woman in Madrid.
options.D: The Prime Minister's decision to call for a snap election on November 29.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，政府是因為其提出的緊急住房法案（旨在減少驅逐並抑制房地產投機）在國會中遭到反對黨聯手否決，才導致了隨後的政治困境。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中未提及最近有大選導致反對黨勝出；選項 C 雖然是民眾憤怒的原因，但它是發生在法案被阻擋之後的社會背景，而非國會表決失敗的直接原因；選項 D 是法案失敗後的結果，而非原因。

quiz.question: Based on the text, why does Prime Minister Sánchez believe a snap election is a strategic necessity?

options.A: He wants to avoid answering questions about his family's legal issues.
options.B: He believes the current minority government is too stable to implement change.
options.C: He hopes to secure a stronger parliamentary majority to bypass reliance on smaller parties.
options.D: He intends to resign from his position regardless of the election outcome.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第三段，桑切斯目前領導的是少數派政府，必須仰賴小黨才能通過法案，這導致施政困難。他推動提前大選的目的是希望獲得更強大的國會支持，從而能更有效地解決國家問題。選項 A 雖然文中提到反對黨會攻擊他的家庭問題，但這並非他決定選舉的動機；選項 B 說「太穩定」與文意相反，應是「太不穩定」；選項 D 文中並未暗示他打算辭職。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'frame' mean as it is used in the context of the election?

options.A: To build a physical structure around something.
options.B: To present a situation in a specific way to influence how people perceive it.
options.C: To falsely accuse someone of a crime they did not commit.
options.D: To change the date of an event on a calendar.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在此語境中，'frame the debate' 指的是將辯論的主題設定在特定框架內，以便引導選民關注對自己有利的議題。這是一種政治修辭手法。選項 A 是字面意義（建築框架），不適用於此；選項 C 是指「誣陷」，不符合上下文；選項 D 與時間安排無關，而是與「觀點設定」有關。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article?

options.A: A detailed history of the Spanish Socialist party since 2018.
options.B: An analysis of the humanitarian crisis occurring at the border of Ceuta.
options.C: A report on the life and career of Alberto Núñez Feijóo.
options.D: The political context and motivations behind Spain's upcoming snap election.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。整篇文章圍繞著西班牙總理桑切斯宣佈提前大選的背景展開，涵蓋了住房危機、政府施政困難、反對黨的挑戰以及政治專家的分析，這些都是為了探討此次大選的動機與影響。選項 A 過於狹隘；選項 B 僅是文中提到的一個次要挑戰；選項 C 僅是選舉中的對手，並非整篇文章的主題。
